_readme: HUMAN-OWNED corrections to bis.json. genbis.js READS this file and never writes it. Generated spec blocks in bis.json are machine-owned and get overwritten on every run, so any disagreement with wowsims belongs HERE instead of being edited into bis.json. Merge happens at slot level: an override for 'head' replaces that slot's entire ranked list and leaves every other slot untouched. You can also override 'weaponConfig', add a slot the preset left empty, or add ranked alternatives (rank 2, 3...) that the wowsims preset has no concept of. Hand-curated specs (those without a _source field in bis.json) are not generated and normally need no overrides — if you do override one, genbis.js flags it in its output. The app reads only itemId and rank; name and source are for human auditing, but source (drop location) is genuinely useful for loot council since generated entries have none.
